jobs.title: Product Manager, SMA
jobs.description:
Job Overview

In this role the incumbent supports the development and execution of global marketing initiatives for a product, indication, customer segment, or disease area. The role translates brand strategy into tactical marketing plans and is responsible for the successful implementation of campaigns, content, congress activities, customer engagement programs, and other commercial initiatives. Working cross-functionally with Medical, Market Access, Analytics, Regulatory, Compliance, and regional market teams, the incumbent ensures marketing activities are aligned with business objectives and customer needs. The role combines strong executional leadership with growing strategic contribution through market insights, campaign optimization, and brand planning support.

Principal Accountabilities
-
- Develop and execute integrated marketing tactics, campaigns, customer engagement initiatives, and content programs aligned to brand objectives.
- Lead agency partners and cross-functional stakeholders to develop, review, and deploy marketing materials and campaign assets.
- Support brand planning through customer insights, market intelligence, competitive analysis, and performance tracking.
- Manage congress planning, external stakeholder engagement activities, promotional review processes, and asset deployment across markets.
- Manage project budgets, agency spend, statements of work, timelines, KPIs, and campaign performance reporting.

Minimum Education Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree required.

- Degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Scientific Discipline, or related field preferred.

- MBA, Master's Degree, or equivalent experience preferred.

- Fluent written and spoken English required.

- Additional language capabilities are advantageous.

Minimum Experience Requirements

- 6-9 years of relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or commercial experience.

- Prior pharmaceutical marketing experience required.

- Experience leading tactical marketing initiatives and campaign execution.

- Experience managing agencies and external vendors.

- Demonstrated understanding of customer engagement and omnichannel marketing approaches.

- Experience working within Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance requirements.

- Direct affiliate or in-market commercial experience preferred.

- Ex-US commercial experience strongly preferred.

- Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.

- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in matrix organizations.

Job Level: Management
Why Biogen?
We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Lead Ophthalmology
jobs.description:
About This Role:

As the Product Lead, Ophthalmology, you will serve as the single point of accountability in Global Product Strategy & Commercialization to maximize the value creation potential of an ophthalmology product for a retinal disease. You will be accountable for overseeing and providing leadership to an integrated cross-functional team to enable geographic expansion into new markets and develop and execute global lifecycle management plans for both new and existing markets.
Additionally, you will be accountable to deliver and execute against strategic priorities to enable sustained market growth, plan and manage against an annual operating budget, and drive a highly effective team performance that spans Commercialization functions, Development, and PO&T across Regions.

What You’ll Do:
- Enable geographic expansion to key identified markets working with the Regions’ commercial teams, particularly with respect to Brazil, China and Japan.
- Identify additional opportunities for geographic expansion and develop business cases for internal review/approval
- Develop robust global lifecycle management plans
- Drive engagement and alignment across functions and regions to enable delivery of program priorities
- Monitor external environment and competition to refine product strategy amidst changing market dynamics

Who You Are: You are a dynamic leader with a strategic mindset and a deep understanding of the biopharma industry. Your strong cross-functional leadership and ability to foster collaboration across diverse teams prepare you to drive business success. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, adept at navigating complex market dynamics with analytical precision. Your passion for innovation and strategic growth drives you to explore new opportunities and lead teams to achieve their fullest potential.

Required Skills:
- 12+ years of experience in a commercial and/or business function in the biopharma industry
- Marketing competence and understanding of go-to market considerations, access considerations and commercial P&L
- Strong cross-functional leadership, planning and organization, analytics, decision-making and problem-solving skills
- Demonstrated experience in managing, leading, coaching, and developing effective teams.

Preferred Skills:
- Experience in ophthalmology and retinal diseases preferred

jobs.title: Senior Regulatory CMC Drug-Device Combination Product Lead
jobs.description:
About This Role:

As the Senior Regulatory CMC Device and Combination Product Lead, you will play a pivotal role in providing Device and Combination Product Regulatory expertise to support the development and implementation of global regulatory strategies.

This position is critical to ensure the clinical and commercial success of key assets, making it highly visible within the organization and across the company. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, lead regulatory submissions, and contribute to the development of processes that advance business objectives. In this role, your work will directly impact the delivery of innovative treatments to patients worldwide, enabling Biogen to maintain its leadership in biotechnology.

What You’ll Do:
- Represent the Regulatory CMC Device function on cross-functional teams and provide regulatory guidance for combination products and medical devices.

- Author and coordinate regulatory documentation and submissions while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations.

- Lead or assist in project assignments supporting business needs, such as representing Regulatory CMC in cross-functional work streams.

- Develop and execute regulatory strategies for medical devices and combination products, including new registration submissions and post-approval applications.

- Communicate CMC regulatory strategies, risks, and overall plans effectively to leadership and cross-functional teams.

- Author, review, and approve CMC submissions and responses to Health Authority questions in alignment with global regulatory strategies and timelines.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare submissions and responses to Health Authority CMC questions for assigned projects and products.

- Monitor and communicate legislative and regulatory developments in relevant areas, ensuring stakeholders are informed of changes.

- Participate in regulatory intelligence activities and trade organization working groups to support corporate objectives.

- Develop and enhance regulatory processes and procedures to align with department goals and objectives.

- Build strong internal relationships with key functions and deliver effective presentations to internal audiences.

Who You Are:

You are a detail-oriented problem solver who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You possess a strong ability to analyze complex regulatory requirements and communicate strategies effectively. You are passionate about advancing innovative medical devices and combination products while ensuring compliance and excellence in your work. You understand the importance of building relationships across teams and take pride in delivering results that drive organizational success.

Required Skills:
- Minimum of a bachelor’s degree (BS) and at least 5 years of regulatory experience, ideally in the medical device, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology industries.

- In-depth understanding of how regulatory functions within a business environment and how Regulatory interfaces with multiple functional areas.

- Experience in Medical Device and/or Combination Product Regulatory Affairs in a similar or junior role.

- Understanding of the application of cGMP for Medical Devices and Combination Products.

- Awareness of applicable legislation, regulations, guidance, and standards related to medical devices and combination products.

- Strong analytical abilities and attention to detail.

Preferred Skills:
- Degree in Life/Health Sciences or Engineering.

Job Level: Management
Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $111,000.00-$149,000.00
Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.

In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being ; including, but not limited to:

- Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
